description: This file implements a budget variance report for an ERP system, including functions to generate report columns, fetch data from the database, process financial data, and generate chart data for visualization.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate columns, data, and chart for the budget variance report based on filters.

methods.name: get_final_data
methods.description: Processes and aggregates data for each dimension and account, computing totals and variances.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Generates report column definitions based on filters and fiscal years.

methods.name: get_cost_centers
methods.description: Retrieves list of cost centers or projects based on filters.

methods.name: get_dimension_target_details
methods.description: Fetches target distribution details for budget dimensions.

methods.name: get_target_distribution_details
methods.description: Retrieves target distribution percentages for accounts of cost centers.

methods.name: get_actual_details
methods.description: Fetches actual financial entries from GL for a given account or cost center.

methods.name: get_dimension_account_month_map
methods.description: Builds a mapping of target and actual data per account, month, and fiscal year.

methods.name: get_fiscal_years
methods.description: Retrieves fiscal years within a specified range.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Generates chart data (labels and datasets) for visualization of budget vs actual expenses.
